name: MONOLlTH DEFENSE [ALPHA]
desc:
Monolith Defense is a tower defense game with fun and expansive gameplay! Give us feedback! We listen to everyone!

🧍🐟Defend against waves of unique enemies like noobs and fish?!
⬆️Upgrade your towers with an elaborate tech tree!
⭐Ascend your towers to upgrade them even further!
💥Use impactful abilities to shift the tide of battle!
🧑‍🤝‍🧑Go in solo or team up with up to 4 player co-op!

❗During this alpha stage of the game everything is subject to change, be aware of constant changes and updates.❗

If you enjoy the game, please like or favorite for more exciting updates! 👍

Premium members earn 5% more gold and xp!
